sovereign_country.strategic_role: 苏伊士运河经济特区、辐射中东及北非的低成本轻工制造

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid Civil Law with Islamic Sharia as the principal source of legislation; unitary national system with no sub-state tax autonomy

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, as amended by Laws No. 36/2014, 80/2016 and 173/2020; Executive Regulations (Prime Ministerial Decree No. 95/2003, as amended); Central Bank of Egypt AML/CFT Rules; Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 as amended by Law No. 4/2018; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMU) directives on UBO identification at incorporation.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of corporate founder's certificate of registration and certificate of good standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or competent authority of founder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Egypt acceded effective 21-Dec-2021) OR Egyptian Consular Legalization for non-Hague issuers

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized board resolution or shareholders' resolution approving establishment of the Egyptian LLC and issuance of a Power of Attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary / notary public of the foreign corporate founder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Egyptian Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney in favor of the Egyptian incorporation agent, Arabic-translated and attested
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in Egypt or foreign notary public with subsequent Egyptian consular attestation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Egyptian Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized passport copies of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country notary public or equivalent attesting officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Egyptian Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO declaration and AML self-certification form (Egyptian statutory form, notarized signatures)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Egyptian notary public in coordination with licensed corporate law firm

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against: (i) UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list; (ii) Egyptian EMU and Central Bank of Egypt domestic lists; (iii) OFAC SDN list and EU financial sanctions lists when USD/EUR payment rails are used; (iv) integrated global PEP database including family members and close associates, with enhanced due diligence for any PEP positive hit. Screening results must be documented, risk-rated, and retained for at least five years after the business relationship ends.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI digital services portal (www.gafi.gov.eg) and the Egyptian Commercial Registry (Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade) unified trade name reservation system
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Arabic is the mandatory statutory language of the corporate name. Each LLC must adopt a name following the Arabic structure 'Activity + Trade Name + Legal Form' (e.g., '... للإنشاءات - ذات مسئولية محدودة'). A Latin transliteration may be registered simultaneously for international contracts and banking but does not replace the Arabic registered name. Foreign names are permitted only as clearly secondary commercial symbols.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: National / Central / Republic / Egypt / Arab Republic
Bank / Insurance / Reinsurance / Investment Fund / Securities
Petroleum / Mining / Electricity (when implying state concession)
Import / Export / Trading (when inconsistent with approved activity)
Any term contrary to public order, public morality, or national security
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the incorporator may file a written administrative appeal with the GAFI Name Clearance Committee within 15 days of the refused decision, providing amended token explanations and supporting trade license evidence. The Committee must issue a decision within 30 days. A rejected name may not be re-filed in identical form; alternatively, a fresh application with modified distinguishing elements can be submitted immediately. Judicial review is available before the Administrative Court under the Unified Administrative Judiciary Law if the administrative appeal is denied.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for an ISIC 4390 high-altitude rope-access façade contractor. The construction license and commercial registration require a physical leasehold or owned executive office in Egypt, evidenced by a notarized lease with municipal attestation; a virtual/PBX-only address is rejected by GAFI and the contracting authority. A serviced private office with dedicated space in a licensed business center may satisfy the statutory office requirement if a physical desk and file storage are provided.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High - 65% likelihood of unannounced on-site physical inspection within the first 12 months of license issuance, driven by Ministry of Labor occupational-safety mandates, civil defense authority audits, and GAFI corporate-compliance verification.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official government filing tariff applied in EGP equivalent (approximate USD 80)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Arabic legal translation and attestation of foreign corporate documents and power of attorney

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting and revision of the LLC Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association under Law 159/1981 and Investment Law 72/2017
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Egyptian corporate counsel / law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a standard LLC incorporation package

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: GAFI One-Stop-Shop and Egyptian Commercial Registry

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation conditional industry license approval fee for ISIC 4390 façade and rope-access construction activity

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Government licensing schedule for activity clearance prior to incorporation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 194 of 2020 (Articles 1-46 for LLC formation, management and registration); Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations (GAFI one-stop-shop route); Commercial Registration Law No. 34 of 1976; Tax Procedures Law No. 206 of 2020
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - One-Stop Shop, Ministry of Investment, in coordination with the Commercial Registry within the Ministry of Trade and Industry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Contract of Incorporation (Aqd Al-Taasis) together with the Articles of Association (El-Nizam El-Dakhily) of the Limited Liability Company, submitted electronically through the GAFI investor portal
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under Law 194 of 2020; capital must be fully subscribed and stated in the contract. Cash contributions must be deposited into a temporary capital deposit account in the company's name at an Egyptian bank, and a bank certificate of deposit must be annexed to the incorporation file; in-kind contributions require a certified valuation report.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: First Board (Managerial) Resolution of [Company Name] LLC, dated ___, 20___. The shareholders having subscribed to the entire issued share capital of EGP ___, the board hereby ratifies the subscription schedule and approves the allotment of shares to the subscribers. The board adopts the premises at [Registered Address, Governorate] as the registered official office and authorizes the company's agent to file the lease and address documents with the Commercial Registry. The board appoints [Name] as Managing Manager, [Name] as Finance Manager, and [Name] as Company Secretary, each vested with execution authority, and authorizes them jointly and severally to complete incorporation, obtain licenses, open bank accounts, and execute all statutory filings. This resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop electronic portal (https://www.gafi.gov.eg) and the Commercial Registry name index
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the electronic name reservation form proposing up to three Arabic or English trade names. The system automatically screens against registered trade names, trademarks and prohibited religious/sovereign terms. Upon approval, download the name reservation certificate valid for 60 days and pay the prescribed reservation fee.
required_dossiers: Passport or national ID of each founding shareholder
Proposed trade names (three alternatives in Arabic and English)
Notarized power of attorney if filed through a local agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, refile with substituted names within 14 days. A formal refusal may be appealed in writing to the GAFI Legal Department within 30 days, attaching trademark search evidence and prior registration precedents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the contract of incorporation and articles of association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Notary Office (Ministry of Justice) or the in-house notary window at GAFI headquarters
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the bilingual contract of incorporation and articles of association using the statutory template provided under Law 194 of 2020. All founders or their legal representatives must appear in person before the notary to verify identity and sign the document; the notary then authenticates the signatures and affixes the notarization stamp.
required_dossiers: Draft contract of incorporation and articles of association
Valid national ID or passport of every founder
Notarized power of attorney for each legal representative, if applicable
Bank certificate of deposit for the fully paid subscribed capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises formal defects, execute a supplementary addendum ratified by all founders. Defects must be cured within 10 working days; failing this, a fresh execution session must be scheduled.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of share capital and issuance of bank certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank licensed by the Central Bank of Egypt (chosen by the founders)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary capital deposit account in the future company's name using the name reservation certificate and the draft notarized contract. Deposit the full subscribed cash capital and obtain a bank certificate of deposit stating the account beneficiary, balance and date of deposit. The bank will block release of funds until the commercial registration certificate is presented.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate issued by GAFI
Draft notarized contract of incorporation
National IDs of founders and designated managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional documentation, obtain a support letter from GAFI's investor services desk. Any discrepancy in the beneficiary name requires an amended contract before deposit proceeds.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic submission to GAFI and entry into the Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop - Commercial Registry window, Ministry of Investment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the notarized incorporation contract, articles of association, bank deposit certificate, registered office lease contract and statutory forms into the GAFI electronic system. Pay the registration and data verification fees. GAFI verifies the file, approves the incorporation, and refers it to the Commercial Registry, which issues the commercial registration certificate and assigns the commercial register number. The company acquires legal personality on the date of registration.
required_dossiers: Notarized contract of incorporation and articles of association
Bank capital deposit certificate
Certified copy of the registered office lease or title document
Name reservation certificate
Photocopies of IDs of shareholders and managers
Tax card application forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: GAFI issues deficiency notes that must be cured within 15 working days. A refusal of registration may be appealed before an internal GAFI committee under Article 81 of the Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 within 30 days; the committee must decide within 60 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration, social insurance and ancillary government registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) and National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the tax card application to the ETA branch and obtain the tax card number plus VAT and e-invoice registration. Register all managers and employees with NOSI within 14 days of the start of activity, and open a bank account to obtain the tax identification number (number of the official file). Obtain any governorate-level trade license or municipal permits required for the registered office.
required_dossiers: Commercial registration certificate
Notarized contract of incorporation
Registered office lease contract
National IDs of managers and employees
Bank account statement and opening certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late filing fines may be assessed under the Tax Procedures Law; submit an ex gratia pardon request with supporting justification to the ETA department head. Social insurance arrears may be settled through an installment agreement with NOSI.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the incorporation summary in the official journal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Official Gazette (Al-Waqa'i Al-Masriya) and the commercial newspaper designated by GAFI
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: GAFI automatically forwards the incorporation summary for publication. The company must verify that the summary appears within 30 days of the commercial registration, obtain certified copies of the publication pages, and retain them for bank and contracting counterparty due diligence.
required_dossiers: Commercial registration certificate
Summary of the incorporation contract prepared by GAFI
Receipt of publication fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the summary is delayed, contact the GAFI Publication Department directly to request expedited issuance. Non-publication does not invalidate legal personality but creates a curable defect; a letter of explanation plus publication proof is acceptable to third parties.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Contractors Classification and Qualification Committee - Egyptian Federation for Construction and Building Contractors (EFCBC) under the Ministry of Housing, Utilities and Urban Communities, in coordination with the Engineering Affairs Department of the local governorate
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Specialized Contractor Classification Certificate for Facade and Rope-Access Works (ISIC 4390) together with the Commercial Permit for Specialty Trade Activities and the High-Altitude Works Safety Permit

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) - Environmental Licensing and Compliance Department
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - Environmental Registration and Simplified Environmental Impact Assessment. Full Category C EIA is not required for facade and rope-access works absent hazardous material manufacturing; a simple screening form and Site Environmental Compliance Declaration are sufficient.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge to public sewer must comply with Law 48 of 1982 Executive Regulations (pH 6-9, BOD not exceeding 60 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 60 mg/L, residual chlorine below 0.4 mg/L). Waste glue, sealant residues and shattered glass are subject to Hazardous Waste Management Decree 338 of 1995 registration and must be documented in the waste tracking manifest. Dust suppression shall keep airborne particulates below ambient limits, and site noise shall not exceed 90 dB(A) at the property boundary.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Clearance certificate from the General Directorate of Civil Defense confirming fire safety equipment, emergency signage and first-aid facilities at the registered office and project sites. Structural load inspection of the roof anchorage and rigging points must be certified by a licensed structural engineer. Occupational safety clearance from the Ministry of Manpower covering work-at-height permits, fall protection inspection, mandatory IRATA Level 1-3 rope-access certification for operatives, and an approved emergency rescue plan.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) under the Ministry of Finance; central e-portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg; e-invoicing portal: https://invoicing.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested Egyptian LLC must file its contract of association, commercial registry certificate, board resolution or power of attorney, and applicable activity licenses with the ETA to obtain a unified Tax Identification Number (TIN) and tax card. Registration is effected through the ETA head office or the electronic tax services portal and must precede any taxable supply, import, or invoicing activity.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egypt does not provide Check-the-Box or hybrid-mismatch classification elections. LLCs are mandatorily taxed at entity level under Law No. 91 of 2005. Relevant practical elections are limited to voluntary VAT registration below the EGP 500,000 threshold, depreciation-method selection under Article 34 of the income tax law, and revaluation elections for assets; no pass-through classification is permitted for LLCs.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) under Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover; mandatory registration applies once supplies exceed this threshold within a 12-month period
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing and e-receipting via the ETA API. Each invoice must be transmitted in JSON/XML format and validated in real time; the ETA returns a unique UUID and QR/stamp before the document is recognized for tax purposes. Taxpayers exceeding the phase thresholds must integrate their ERPs or billing systems with the ETA network, apply an electronic QR code, and keep digital records for at least 10 years.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods are zero-rated under the VAT Law where the export is evidenced by a customs export declaration. Services are zero-rated when rendered and consumed wholly outside Egypt, or directly connected to exported goods, including construction and installation services performed on foreign-located structures. The high-altitude facade services qualify only where the physical worksite is outside Egypt and all economic activity occurs abroad; zero-rating does not apply to services consumed in Egypt.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bayan) bearing the ETA customs office stamp and unique export number
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical removal from Egypt
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice proving FX repatriation of export proceeds
Signed contract and commercial invoice referencing the zero-rated export supply
Proof of service performance abroad (site presence, completion reports) for offshore services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unsubstantiated export zero-rating triggers reassessment of VAT at 14%, withdrawal of the refund, and a penalty of up to 100% of the evaded tax plus additional daily late-interest; administrative fines of EGP 20,000 to EGP 1,000,000 apply for electronic invoicing violations, and deliberate misdeclaration carries criminal indictment and imprisonment under Law No. 67 of 2016. The ETA may also claw back refunds for up to five years and assess transfer-pricing adjustments where export pricing is distorted.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) — statutory mandate under the Central Bank and Banking System Law No. 194 of 2020, the Foreign Exchange Law No. 38 of 1994, and delegated prudential directives issued by the CBE Board of Directors, coordinated with the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) and the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Since the 6 March 2024 exchange-rate unification, the EGP operates as a bank-intermediated managed float with daily weighted-average interbank fixing. Current-account transactions (construction services exports, goods imports) are freely convertible upon documentary compliance (signed subcontracts, pro-forma invoices, import declaration forms). Capital-account transactions — foreign equity injections, shareholder loans, profit remittance — remain administratively restricted: foreign capital must be registered with GAFI or the CBE to secure future repatriation rights, and profit remittance requires audited financial statements, ETA tax clearance, and the original inflow registration. Practical remittance clearing takes 5–15 business days. EGP is not yet fully Article VIII (IMF) convertible; residual surrender and registration obligations persist on capital transfers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Services export proceeds must be credited to the EG_LLC's designated foreign-currency account at an Egyptian licensed bank within a maximum of 90 days from the invoice date, extendable to 180 days by the dealing bank upon contract-backed justification. Under the CBE directive effective with the 2023–2024 unified-rate framework, 50% of gross services export proceeds must be converted into EGP at the bank's daily published market rate; strategic industrial goods exports are subject to a higher 70% conversion ratio unless expressly exempted. The un-surrendered 50% may be retained in USD in the same export-proceeds account for hedging collateral, import settlements, or permitted distributions. All receipts must flow through the Egyptian designated bank; settlement via any third-country intermediary is treated as non-repatriation and subjects the entity to CBE supervisory sanctions and restriction of new FX facilities. The treasury mandate of the EG_LLC must auto-adapt to the CBE ratio table in force on the date of each receipt.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational EGP account + USD export-proceeds sub-account; capital escrow / tender-bond guarantee side-account for mobilization guarantees
Operational EGP + USD paired account; progress-billing receipts lockbox; import LC desk
USD/EGP dual-currency operational account with InstaPay and EG-Credit ACH clearing; contract-segregated project escrow
Multi-currency cross-border treasury account (EGP / USD / EUR) optimized for GCC disbursements
Pooled treasury account: EGP concentration account + USD sweep module for FX forward collateral
Contract-linked escrow and guarantee account for back-to-back import LCs on facade material procurement

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for primary treasury operations. Egyptian law does not recognize an electronic money institution (EMI) banking category; only CBE-licensed banks may accept corporate deposits, issue corporate IBANs, or clear through EGCH / InstaPay. The Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) licenses non-bank payment service providers that may facilitate wallets and payment initiation but cannot hold commercial balances or originate SWIFT MT103. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise-type, Qonto, Bankera) cannot onboard the EG_LLC for EGP receipts, cannot apply the CBE export-proceeds surrender standing order, and their use would render proceeds non-repatriated. Permissible ancillary use: a non-resident disbursement-only virtual IBAN for paying GCC-based subcontractor payroll, provided no EGP clearing and no surrender obligation attaches. The primary treasury must remain at NBE, Banque Misr, or CIB.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory. The CBE AML/CFT Rulebook (Regulation No. 39 of 2022, Title II) requires first-time corporate account approval to be supported by face-to-face identification of at least one authorized director-signatory and the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) at a physical branch. Remote video-KYC is reserved for low-risk natural-person consumer onboarding and is not available for fresh corporate accounts. A non-resident director may delegate signing authority through a notarized and Egyptian-consular legalized power of attorney, but the foreign UBO remains obliged to attend one 30-minute structured compliance interview in Egypt. Estimated onboarding lead time: 3–5 business days with a resident co-signatory path; 7–15 business days when foreign UBO travel is required. The original corporate seal and the LLC's commercial registry certificate must be presented in branch.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nominee-shareholder or multi-layer holding structure obscuring the natural-person UBO of the EG_LLC.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full UBO register under Article 23 of AML Law No. 80 of 2002 (as amended); corporate chain chart from the LLC to each ultimate natural person; notarized declarations from each intermediate holding entity; certified passports and six-month bank statements of every UBO; written legal opinion from an Egyptian-licensed attorney confirming compliance with CBE AML Circular No. 3 of 2015.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident director or UBO without Egyptian national ID, Tax Card, or local address evidence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Consular-certified foreign passport; home-country utility bill dated within three months; current-year foreign tax-residency certificate (TRC); ETA registration receipt for the LLC; board resolution appointing the foreign director, translated by an accredited legal translator; declaration of residential address in Egypt for the local representative.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value service invoices to a single offshore general contractor (GCC supertall facade project) flagged as potential trade-based money laundering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed subcontract and detailed scope of work; ISIC 4390 sector license issued by the competent Egyptian governorate; IRATA-certified rope-access technician roster with payroll records; Contractor's All-Risk and employer's liability insurance certificates; project invoice numbering traceable to the Progress ACH and Wire Transfer payment rails; bank transaction-monitoring questionnaire completed by the CFO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound USD equity injection exceeding 25% of stated paid-in capital without documented source of wealth.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six months of pre-credit bank statements of the contributing shareholder; share purchase or subscription agreement; GAFI foreign-capital registration certificate (under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017) or CBE foreign-capital declaration under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981; source-of-wealth letter from a recognized chartered accountant; board resolution authorizing the capital increase.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Export-proceeds misdeclaration or attempted routing of milestone payments through a third-country clearing account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete SWIFT MT103 trail evidencing the original remitting client and beneficiary account; contract clause naming the Egyptian designated account; CBE export-proceeds collection form completed by the bank; reconciliation statement between open work orders and receipts; standing instruction for mandatory 50% EGP conversion executed on the credit date.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: SWIFT MT103 from the foreign shareholder to the EG_LLC USD account at CIB (BIC CIBEEGCX) or NBE (BIC NBEGEGCX); the MT103 narrative must recite 'equity capital contribution per EG_LLC shareholders' resolution dated [date]' and the CBE Balance-of-Payments purpose code 'F01 – Equity capital of direct investment enterprise' (BPM6 code 3235). Compliance package filed with the receiving bank before first credit: (i) board resolution; (ii) updated commercial registry extract; (iii) GAFI investment registration or CBE foreign-capital declaration; (iv) source-of-funds dossier comprising six-month shareholder statements and subscription agreement; (v) valid tax card. The bank issues a stamped inward-remittance certificate evidencing the USD credit. Equity injections are exempt from the 50% export-proceeds surrender ratio. Treasury policy: maintain 30% of injected working capital in EGP via same-day CBE TOM auto-conversion and 70% in USD overnight deposits to fund mobilization bonds; pre-fund milestone payment obligations only against a confirmed LC or letter-of-intent from the prime contractor.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Rail hierarchy: (1) consumables and anchor hardware up to USD 250,000 — SWIFT MT103 open-account settlement through the bank's correspondent network (USD via New York, EUR via Frankfurt) against pro-forma invoice; (2) project-integral imports (structural glass, aluminum curtain-wall units, access winch systems, USD 250,000–2,000,000) — irrevocable documentary Letter of Credit (MT700) at 80% sight / 20% deferred-90-days tenor via NBE or Banque Misr trade desks, with the 2023–2024 CBE relaxation permitting documents-against-payment (D/P) for non-strategic goods as a fallback; (3) domestic EGP disbursements — EG-Credit ACH batch for subcontractor payments, InstaPay instant rails for urgent permit fees (respecting CBE per-transaction caps), and bulk salary ACH validated against the rope-access crew IBANs; (4) all foreign-currency disbursements require the underlying contract and ETA import declaration to pass the bank's transaction-monitoring engine.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/EGP FX forwards with 1–12 month tenors executed at CBE-licensed dealing banks; margin requirement 10–20%, collateralizable by the un-surrendered 50% USD export proceeds.
USD/EGP FX swaps (SPOT-NEXT, T/N, and 1M–6M legs) for intra-month liquidity bridging between general-contractor milestone receipts and supplier payment dates.
USD/EGP cross-currency interest-rate swaps (CCIRS) for hedge of long-dated retained-amount exposure, subject to CBE notification and proof of underlying services-export contract.

Onshore exchange-traded EGP futures are not admitted on EGX; offshore USD/EGP NDFs are not lawful for Egyptian-licensed banks in their Egyptian books — residual GCC-currency risk may be managed by the foreign parent outside Egypt under group treasury policy.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Juridical Income Tax Return (Corporate Income Tax Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due within 4 months after the end of the LLC's fiscal year; for calendar-year LLCs, on or before April 30 of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late assessed tax carries statutory monthly interest; delayed filing triggers incremental monthly late-filing penalties (up to 2% per month or part thereof) and ETA forced assessment. Willful non-filing can escalate to fine litigation and attachment of company accounts; prolonged failure may lead ETA to request the Commercial Registry to suspend the firm's tax card and registration status.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registration Office, Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade / General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On the annual anniversary date of the commercial registration certificate; resubmission of current manager data and payment of the renewal fee is required. Renewal should be completed no later than the end of the anniversary month to avoid delay sanctions.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to renew on time triggers a late-renewal fine; after the statutory warning period, the Commercial Registry may suspend the registration, and continued default for approximately 90 days may initiate administrative strike-off of the LLC's record, with loss of corporate legal standing and trading capacity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - tax office where the LLC is registered
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, to be effective January 1 of each calendar year; application must be submitted in December of the preceding year and in all cases before the card's expiry date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Operating with an expired tax card subjects the LLC to a stamp-tax fine and bars the card's use in notarizations, bank account transactions, customs clearance, tender participation, and government licensing procedures; continued non-renewal may cause ETA to block related commercial registry transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) through the electronic investor services system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At least once per calendar year and within 30 days of any change in beneficial ownership; annual 'no-change' confirmations are due by March 31 of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-confirmation or stale UBO data triggers administrative fines, suspension of electronic corporate filings, blocking of share transfers, and can lead GAFI to suspend the company's annual certificate and registration transactions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under Egyptian Companies Law and GAFI-implemented investment requirements, every LLC is required to prepare annual financial statements and submit them to an independent audit without any statutory exemption based on size, revenue, or number of employees. The auditor must be a licensed Egyptian audit practitioner/accounting firm acceptable to ETA and GAFI.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), as issued by the Egyptian Ministry of Finance and based on IFRS; IFRS is required for listed entities and may be used for investment-license companies with GAFI approval.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must keep a written UBO register at its registered office and file an annual confirmation through GAFI's electronic platform. For every share transfer, the register is updated before the transfer is recorded; a 'no-change' annual declaration is also obligatory. The protocol applies without regard to shareholding size thresholds set in the AML law, and requires current identification documents for every natural person ultimately owning or controlling the LLC.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Investment Law 72/2017 permits partial tax holidays up to 50% for qualifying projects in priority sectors and Suez Canal Economic Zone projects; additional deduction of 50% of qualifying production activities for small and medium enterprises under Law 152/2020; super-accelerated depreciation available on certain asset classes.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 37 (Corporate Income Tax Return) e-filed through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) online portal or submitted in person to the competent tax office.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four months after the end of the fiscal year (12-month tax period).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company identification: legal name, tax card number, tax identification number (TIN), registered address, fiscal year period, industry code (ISIC 4390 / NAICS 238990).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the LLC is subject to a permanent establishment (PE) filing obligation, provide the PE tax registration number and attach the declaration of activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross receipts: all Egypt-sourced revenue from rope-access facade services, structural glass replacement, project management, and subcontracting, reported net of sales discounts and VAT.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report revenue attributable to the Egyptian PE in accordance with Article 24, Law 91/2005; exclude remittances not connected to local operations if properly documented.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales and deductible operating expenses: direct materials, subcontracted specialist labor, equipment depreciation, safety certification costs, site leasing, transport, insurance, and administrative overheads.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses allocable to the PE may be deducted on a supported basis; transfer pricing adjustments must be made for any cross-border intercompany charges.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income before incentives: gross receipts minus cost of sales and other deductible items, then adjusted for non-deductible expenditures, depreciation methods, and provisions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure all intra-group services are priced at arm's length and be prepared to submit the TP Local File if controlled transactions exceed the statutory threshold.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax incentives and income tax computation: apply tax holiday or additional deduction percentages, then apply the 22.5% statutory rate; calculate the assessed corporate income tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident taxpayers must document the entitlement and source of any tax holiday; any treaty rate reduction must be evidenced by a valid Egyptian PE and TRC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty: EGP 500–5,000 per month of delay plus an additional 2% of the tax due for each month, up to a maximum of 100% of the assessed tax. Misstatement or non-filing can trigger automated audits, additional fines, and criminal prosecution for evasion.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The non-resident recipient must obtain a Certificate of Tax Residency (TRC) from the treaty jurisdiction, present it to the Egyptian payer before dividend distribution, and file an approved application (Form 19) with the ETA. Upon clearance, the reduced treaty WHT rate applies; otherwise the statutory 10% rate is withheld at source.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic rates: royalties 20%, interest 20% on Egypt-sourced payments to non-residents. Under many treaties (e.g., US-Egypt 15%, UK-Egypt 15%), rates may be reduced to 15% or lower, provided the TRC and beneficial ownership documentation is furnished. Banking interest on certain trade financing may be treated as ordinary business profit under treaty protection.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is mandatory where related-party transactions in the fiscal year exceed EGP 5 million. Master File is required for MNE groups with consolidated revenues exceeding EGP 50 million. Spontaneous filing deadlines align with the tax return due date.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not maintain a separate Economic Substance Regulation (ESR) regime, but economic substance is comprehensively tested through the general anti-avoidance rule (Article 47, Law 91/2005), the substance-over-form doctrine, and TP rules. A company must demonstrate real local staff, physical assets, and operational management to sustain deductible expenses and treaty benefits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willfully understating revenue from rope-access project contracts, using forged invoices, or creating fictitious subcontractor expenses to reduce taxable profit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine equal to 100%–200% of evaded tax and imprisonment for up to five years; ETA may also confiscate assets equal to the evaded tax amount.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a conduit invoice vehicle with no actual employees, safety equipment, contracts, or on-site performance in Egypt while directing profits to offshore entities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disallowance of all claims, recharacterization of transactions, additional tax of 30% of underpaid amounts, and potential revocation of the commercial registration and required construction licenses.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare or file the Local File/Master File, or engaging in intercompany charges materially deviating from the arm's length price for facade project management services.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Compensatory adjustment of taxable income, penalty of 30% of the additional assessed tax, plus a fine up to EGP 500,000 for failure to provide documentation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Making dividend, royalty, or interest payments to non-residents without effecting the required statutory WHT deduction or without obtaining the treaty concession in advance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Personal liability of the payer for the undischarged WHT amount, plus a late-payment monthly penalty and a fine not exceeding EGP 20,000 (or imprisonment in cases of willful misapplication).

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using a network of shell suppliers and foreign companies to launder proceeds through fake rope-access consultancy invoices or inflated materials procurement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Freezing of assets, confiscation of laundered property and related profits, imprisonment up to ten years, fines up to EGP 500,000, and permanent travel bans for directors involved.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Directors approving or knowingly participating in unlawful tax schemes, sham transactions, or unjustified dividend distributions lacking adequate capital.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Personal civil restitution for unpaid corporate taxes and penalties under the Companies Law and Article 74-bis of Law 91/2005, court-imposed travel bans, disqualification from board positions, and imprisonment for fraud offenses.
